macros.name: changetextnotescontentsname
macros.doc: To change the name of the textual notes section in the table of contents (the default is “Textual Notes”) issue \changetextnotescontentsname.

macros.name: changetextnotesname
macros.doc: To change the title in the text for the endnote section for textual notes (the default is TEXTUAL NOTES), issue \changetextnotesname{yourversion}.

macros.name: definenewnotetype
macros.doc: You can create as many new kinds of endnote sections as you wish, using the \definenewnotetype command.

macros.name: literaltextnote
macros.doc: \literaltextnote and its siblings are useful for sending information directly to the endnotes section to which the command refers.

macros.name: maketextnotes
macros.doc: \maketextnotes opens an external file with the extension .ent.

macros.name: notemarkintext
macros.doc: You can put the endnote markers in the main text rather than in the margins by issuing \notemarkintext in your preamble.

macros.name: notesbychapter
macros.doc: resets the note counters for each kind of endnote and puts a centered line reading “Chapter <chapter number > <chapter title>” in each of the three predefined sections of the the notes whenever \chapter is issued.

macros.name: notesincontents
macros.doc: To include a line for the endnotes in the table of contents, issue \notesincontents or (toggling the boolean) \notesincontentsontrue.

macros.name: notesincontentsonfalse
macros.doc: If you do not wish to include a line for the endnotes in the table of contents, issue \notesincontentsonfalse.

macros.name: notesincontentsontrue
macros.doc: To include a line for the endnotes in the table of contents, issue \notesincontents or (toggling the boolean) \notesincontentsontrue.

macros.name: putemendations
macros.doc: This macro closes external file for emendations, reads it in, and puts an entry for the emendations into the table of contents file.

macros.name: putexplanatory
macros.doc: \puttextnotes, \putexplanatory, or \putemendation read the external files back into your document at the place you specify.

macros.name: puttextnotes
macros.doc: \puttextnotes, \putexplanatory, or \putemendation read the external files back into your document at the place you specify.

macros.name: setupendnoteheaders
macros.doc: \setupendnoteheaders opens an external channel to receive each of the three preset kinds of endnote, opening external files for emendations, textual collations, and explanatory notes (with extensions .emd, .ent, and .enx respectively).

macros.name: titleinnotesfalse
macros.doc: If you want only the chapter number, not its title, issue \titleinnotesfalse in your preamble.
